headline: Ringgit Edges Lower Against US Dollar Ahead of US Inflation Data
summary: The ringgit closed slightly lower versus the US dollar on the back of risk appetite dynamics ahead of key US inflation data releases.
why: Malaysian financial markets and exchange rates react to shifts in US macroeconomic data and Federal Reserve policy expectations.

impacts.name: Malaysian ringgit
impacts.why: A stronger US dollar and cautious positioning pushed the currency slightly lower.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Anticipation surrounding upcoming US inflation metrics created volatility in emerging market currencies.
